rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13980 §§1–6, 86 FR 6817–6820 (PDF pp.1–4). Sections 2 and 4 govern regulatory-crime transparency, mens rea statements, justification of strict liability and OIRA guidance/monitoring. Section 5 directs guidance on criminal referrals and limits its effect on investigations. The 45-day guidance timetable is not an expiration of the prospective regulatory and referral regime. EO 14029 §1, PDF p.1, explicitly revokes EO 13980 by number and title without reserving §§4–5. Section 2's qualified cleanup of implementing actions is distinct from that unconditional revocation. EO 13980 §6(c)'s national-security, Justice Department, goods, plea, employment and other exclusions define original scope; §§6(a),(b),(d) preserve independent legal authority, appropriations constraints and noncreation of private rights. They do not preserve any EO 13980 command after revocation. Completed referrals and regulations may have independent consequences. EO 14148 §2(gg) revokes EO 14029, but neither that clause nor §3's review directives affirmatively re-enacts EO 13980. No supplied source establishes restoration.
